units.source_text: 藤左卫门和忠左卫门互相对视而笑。

en.t: Tozaemon and Chuzaemon looked at each other and smiled.

units.source_text: 他们得知复仇的事情给江户人的内心产生的的影响，不管多么细微的变化，也一定是非常开心的。

en.t: They must have been very pleased to learn that the revenge had affected the hearts of the people of Edo, however slight the change might have been.

units.source_text: 只有内藏助一个人，他一手撑着额头，面露不耐，一声不吭。

en.t: Only Kuranosuke sat alone with one hand propping up his forehead, impatience on his face, saying nothing at all.

units.source_text: 他原本对自己相当满意，藤左卫门的话，在他的心头投射出了不可言语的阴影。

en.t: He had been quite satisfied with himself, but Tozaemon's words cast an indescribable shadow over his heart.

units.source_text: 虽然是这么回事，他没必要为自己做过的事负责任。

en.t: Even so, he had no need to take responsibility for what he had done.

units.source_text: 就算他们完成了复仇后，复仇在江户城内流行起来，他也对得起自己的良心。

en.t: Even if revenge became fashionable in Edo Castle after they had carried it out, his conscience would still be clear.

units.source_text: 虽然如此说，但他还是觉得自己心里原来漫漫的热烈情绪凉下去了几分。

en.t: Still, he felt that the passionate feeling which had filled his heart was cooling somewhat.
